suite.name: Visual Regression - Screenshot Baseline
suite.description: Demonstrates assert_screenshot against the simplest possible stable page (a single static paragraph, no images/webfonts). NOTE: Playwright names baseline snapshots per-OS (e.g. '...-win32.png'), so a baseline generated on Windows is never found/used on a Linux CI runner and vice versa - this suite is validated in CI but intentionally NOT executed there; run it locally with `npm run qa:run -- suites/visual-regression.json` (add QA_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=true once to (re)generate your own OS's baseline first).
